title: 00K9: Operation Christmas
overview: When a devious black panther known as Sharposky uses the psychic powers of the ancient mastodons to render CIA's Major Oddball powerless, the Agency's most trusted operative, Agent 00K9 must cut his Christmas vacation short to confront the wicked panther head on and prevent an attack on Knightsbury on Christmas Eve. It's sleigh bells and thrills with 00K9: Operation Christmas.
